Well Pump Repair & Tankless Water Heater Installation in Saxapahaw, NC

Saxapahaw homes primarily use groundwater from a well system as their water source. Whether you use a community well from Saxapahaw Utility Company or have your own private well, our licensed plumbers are trained to handle plumbing issues that are connected to these types of infrastructures. The goal at Happy Home is to ensure you have consistent water flow from your sinks and showers to your toilets.

Well Pump Repair in Saxapahaw, NC

Your well pump is the main connector between your groundwater and pressure tank. Without a functioning well pump, the process of getting water to your home is broken. Happy Home plumbers understand that losing access to water requires urgent repairs. With extensive knowledge of well pump systems and trucks fully stocked with the right tools, our plumbers have your repair needs covered.

Tankless Water Heater Installation in Saxapahaw, NC

With Saxapahaw being an eco-conscious community, upgrading your tank water heater system to a tankless one is a green move. When you decide to install a tankless water heater, water is only heated on demand as opposed to keeping a reservoir of water constantly heated until you need it. When you work with a Happy Home plumber, they will go over different makes and models of systems so you can choose the right upgrade that meets your expectations.

Ductless Mini-Splits & Heat Pumps for Saxapahaw Lofts and Older Homes

As a historical mill town, Saxapahaw has worked to curate original structures and transform them into usable living environments. When working to turn these landmarks into usable facilities, there’s a balance in maintaining their integrity while delicately implementing modern-day appliances. Today’s lineup of HVAC systems offers minimally invasive units, such as mini-splits, as well as high-efficiency systems including heat pumps. Happy Home works with all major makes and models of HVAC systems. Our technicians provide custom recommendations that fit historical homes or suburban developments that need an energy-efficient alternative.

Mini-Split Installation in Saxapahaw, NC

Mini-split systems do not require intricate ductwork. Instead, they are installed directly in the specific room where you need climate control. With our expertise in mini-split systems, our licensed HVAC technicians can walk you through the minimally invasive installation process and how these systems provide an energy-efficient solution.

Heat Pump Repair in Saxapahaw, NC

With our mild winters, heat pumps are an exceptional system to have in your home. In just one system, you get both your cooling and heating demands covered. Since it utilizes electricity, you eliminate on-site fuel sources. The team at Happy Home conducts detailed repairs and thorough routine maintenance on these systems, so you’re comfortable year-round.

Whole-Home Dehumidifiers for Haw River Humidity

Living by the Haw River is one of the many scenic features that make up Saxapahaw.
